app.name: Long Walks Atlas
app.description: A map of long-distance walking trails across Europe: pilgrim ways, historic routes, coastal and mountain paths, with length, days on foot and a link to each official site.

disclaimer.short: Lines on the map are schematic. For the exact route, see each trail's official website.
disclaimer.trail: The line on the map is schematic and may differ from the waymarked trail. For the exact route, its stages and current changes, see the official website: <link>{{site}}</link>.

og.tagline: Pilgrim ways, historic routes, coastal and mountain trails across Europe, on one map.

atlas.title: Europe's long-distance hiking trails on a map
